bodyDescription: Spoil your dog with these Voskes Chicken Fillet slices, made from 100% fresh chicken breast, with no added colours, flavourings or preservatives. This dried chicken fillet is low in fat and easily digestible, excellent for overweight and allergic dogs. Moreover, this snack is a rich & nutritious source of animal protein, essential in your dog's nutritional needs.
